sql_template: SELECT trade_date, strategy_name, strategy_version, strategy_instance_key, universe, universe_label, subject_code, subject_name, rank_no, value_decimal, strategy_detail_json, snapshot_time FROM aiia_stock_strategy_result_daily WHERE trade_date = :trade_date AND strategy_name = :strategy_name AND strategy_version = :strategy_version AND strategy_instance_key = :strategy_instance_key AND universe = :universe ORDER BY rank_no ASC LIMIT :limit

trade_date.description: Target trade date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

strategy_instance_key.description: Momentum window instance such as k_4 or k_5.

universe.description: Universe key. Empty string means full market.

audit.notes: Template prepares a parameterized query for stored momentum strategy results.
